investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: plain curl GET (descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser) of the venue's own official concerts programme page and one individual event detail page. The programme page is server-rendered static HTML (MODX CMS with pdoTools pagination, not WordPress). Each of 9 sampled event cards states its own title, a full machine-readable local datetime in a `data-dateStart` attribute, a matching human-readable date/time, a price in EUR, and a link to the event's own detail page.

probe_history.reason: The public concerts programme page (https://www.urbanspree.com/program/concerts/) is plain server-rendered HTML exposing event cards, each with its own title, a full 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' local datetime in a data-dateStart attribute (repeated as human-readable text), an explicit EUR price, and a link to its own detail page. This directly answers the investigation question without needing to escalate. No JSON-LD, ICS feed, WordPress plugin, Fourvenues widget, or Sanity CMS was found (this is a MODX/pdoTools-powered site, not WordPress).

venue_reference: Urban Spree (1700 sqm artistic space and concert venue, Revaler Str. 99, RAW-Gelände, Berlin-Friedrichshain)

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence: the venue's own domain (urbanspree.com), its own page <title> ('... Urban Spree - Berlin / Concerts / Program'), and its own navbar logo/branding. Discovered via WebSearch (not treated as authority itself) and independently confirmed by fetching the domain directly.

site_classification.platform: MODX CMS with the pdoTools extra (pdoPage pagination component visible in loaded assets/scripts) rendering static event cards server-side — not WordPress, no queryable events REST API found.

title.value: Pure Obsessions & Red Nights + Nico Amara…
title.notes:
Each event card's own

states the full title directly. Sampled representative value from the first card on the retained page; the same structure repeats identically across all 9 sampled cards.

start_date.notes: Each event card's own machine-readable data-dateStart attribute states a full 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' local datetime directly (e.g. data-dateStart="2027-04-23 20:00:00"), independently corroborated by the card's own human-readable 'Apr 23, 2027' text in the same card — no combination with page-level or heading context needed; every card carries its own complete date.

time.notes: Each card's own data-dateStart attribute and human-readable text also state a time ('20:00:00' / '20:00') directly, but with no UTC offset or explicit timezone anywhere on the page — a floating local time only, not a confirmed instant. Consistent with this project's v1.2 worked example (example-deterministic-context-ready-01), a floating local time is retained honestly as PARTIAL rather than promoted to a precise PROVEN value.

end.notes: No end date/time is stated anywhere on the event card or the sampled event detail page.

venue_location.notes: Not stated per-event-card as a discrete field. This source represents exactly one physical venue (Urban Spree, Revaler Str. 99) — consistent with this project's existing single-venue-per-source precedent (e.g. razzmatazz-barcelona-01), venue identity is intended to resolve via source_id at activation time, not by parsing a per-record field the source does not actually expose.

source_record_id.notes: No numeric or explicit id field is exposed on the card. Each event's own detail-page URL ('program/concerts/{slug}.html') uses a stable, source-authored filename/slug as this source's own canonical permalink — the same documented judgement already established for LAV (ingestion/lav/discovery.mjs) and moog-barcelona-01/badehaus-berlin-01. The slug is directly read from the source's own link markup, not inferred.

event_url.notes: Each event card's own <a href="program/concerts/{slug}.html"> states the relative path directly; the page's own <base href="https://www.urbanspree.com/"/> resolves it to an absolute URL deterministically (a fixed, standard HTML resolution rule, not model judgement) — recorded here as the resolved absolute form actually fetched and confirmed to return the matching event detail page (evidence/event-detail.html).

price.notes: Each event card's own <li class="list-group-item price ..."> states a EUR price directly (e.g. '17.00€' on the sampled card) — no combination or inference needed.

reasons: Identity PROVEN directly from retained evidence.
acquisition_class STATIC_HTML, a resolved supported class, with a CONFIRMED public data path (9 real, current event cards sampled from the live page).

title and start_date both PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE, each stated directly and completely (including a machine-readable data-dateStart attribute) on every sampled event card — no context combination needed.
price also PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE, an unusually complete static-HTML source for this project.
source_record_id PROVEN via a documented URL-slug strategy, matching this project's existing LAV/moog-barcelona-01/badehaus-berlin-01 precedent.
recommended_family STATIC_EVENT_LIST, an existing named family in this project's collector-family vocabulary.

Decision intentionally stops at READY_FOR_OFFLINE_PROOF, not READY_FOR_ACTIVATION: this investigation retains no DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION evidence item (no collector/parser code or offline fixture reproduction was written in this task), which gate 9 of the activation gates requires. Building and offline-proving the STATIC_EVENT_LIST parser against the retained evidence/program-page.html fixture is separate, explicitly follow-up work.

DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION offline-proof evidence now retained (tests/urban-spree.test.mjs), reproducing this investigation's own retained fixtures deterministically and offline — gate 9/v1.2 satisfied. Advanced from READY_FOR_OFFLINE_PROOF to READY_FOR_ACTIVATION.
